candidates.reason: Sensible top-to-bottom reflow (logo + badge row, two-line headline, product circle), but the circle runs to within ~15px of the bottom edge and almost touches the sides, so the bottom feels jammed. The badge's tilt and spacing next to the logo look improvised, and the 'SOLSTICE' label is tiny.

Almost the same as candidate 1, with slightly more bottom margin under the circle and a tidier logo/badge row. The circle still nearly touches the side edges, the headline-to-circle gap is uneven compared with the cramped top row, and 'SOLSTICE' is very small.

The 'NEW VIDEO' badge collides with and partly covers the logo, a clear unwanted overlap that damages the brand mark. The headline is smaller and loses dominance to the oversized circle, which nearly touches both side edges. Dead space is left at the bottom.

The original was just shrunk into a thin middle band of the tall canvas: the logo, headline, badge and 'SOLSTICE' are all tiny or unreadable, roughly 70% of the canvas is empty background, and the layout was not adapted to the vertical format at all.
